notes.title: New Version Update! Thanks for Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Hello to all players of No Return!

We are the development team behind No Return.
 We have received all your feedback and are working to further optimize and resolve the issues within our game. We appreciate your patience and understanding! Here are the issues that have been fixed in this update:


 Further reduced the flashing effects in some scenes.

 Increased the brightness in certain scenes.

 Fixed the bug where trolleys in the car scene could bypass barriers and get stuck in obstacles.

 Fixed the bug where talismans couldn't be selected.

We will continue to address and fix more bugs and issues that exist in the game. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update!
notes.content:
Dear all,

BlameTech here, the dev team for "No Return".

First off, thank you for playing our game...even though the experience had been negative so far. 
We've received your feedback regarding the bugs in the game and the issues with overly bright or dark scenes. We're made note of it and immediately made the following changes:


 Black screen bug during chase sequences
 Game freeze bug when opening the refrigerator before the chase sequence in level 7
 Game freeze bug when unable to pick up the kitchen knife after the car door closes in level 7
 Game freeze bug when getting stuck inside the bathroom in level 6


We continue to keep fixing bugs and issues related to overly bright and dark scenes. We also hope that the critical issues are resolved. Please feel free to directly let us know on Discord if you encounter issues.

Sincerely,
BlameTech

notes.title: Game Patch No.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to express our heartfelt thanks for your continued support and feedback. As we did work on the game for a long time, we deeply value each player's input and have released a new update tonight to enhance your experience based on the game reviews so far.

In this update, we have made the following adjustments:

[olist]
 Removed the debug mode from the game to ensure a smoother and more immersive experience.

 Significantly reduced light flickering and red light effects, and increased the overall brightness. We hope these changes will improve your gameplay experience.
[/olist]

We are committed to providing you with the best possible experience, and we appreciate your understanding and support. Please feel free to share any further suggestions or feedback with us.

Thank you all!
Blametech team

Feel free to chat with us/give immediate feedback to the team on Discord

notes.title: No Return: An note about our demo size!
notes.content:
Hello all,

First off, a massive thank you to everyone who’s tried out the No Return demo during the first day of Steam Next Fest! 🎉 We're beyond excited to have you dive into our game.

Now, let's address the mammoth in the room – our demo’s install size. We noticed some of you might have seen a whopping 34GB download size and thought, "Is this an RPG or did I just install the entire internet?"

Fear not! This is a bit of a mix-up on Steam's end. The actual size of our demo is a much more manageable 16GB. We promise, No Return hasn’t decided to include a hidden library of medieval literature in its files.

So...to clarify:

 The install size shows up as 34GB.
 IT'S REALLY JUST 16GB
 Your internet connection will breathe a sigh of relief.


We apologize for the confusion and appreciate your patience as we sort this out. We want your experience to be smooth and enjoyable, not to mention a tad bit quicker to start playing!

Thank you again for your support and enthusiasm. If you encounter any issues or have questions, don’t hesitate to reach out. Join the conversation on Twitter and Discord. We’re always here to chat, laugh, and troubleshoot together!

Twitter：https://x.com/playnoreturn
Discord：https://discord.com/invite/cD95F9dG3e


Happy venturing through the halls, and we hope you enjoy the rest of Steam Next Fest!

Cheers, 
The "No Return" Team

notes.title: No Return is BACK!! COMING THIS SUMMER!!
notes.content:
First-person Chinese horror game "No Return" returns! The game is set to release this summer!

"No Return" will participate in the Steam Next Fest on June 11th, with a free demo available starting today. Players can download it now to experience the eerie and terrifying atmosphere ahead of time and explore the cruel secrets hidden behind familiar daily life! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283152/08ca165a79d08c65b9cce9bf53bfde2a7304854a.jpg

The demo lasts approximately 20 minutes and will be available until the end of the Next Fest on June 17th. The game begins on a familiar route home, where the protagonist returns from work to find their once cozy home in ruins. Past warmth flashes back in scenes, and everything that has happened and is hidden behind it awaits players to experience and uncover!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967220/

Game Description:
"No Return" is a psychological horror game set behind the façade of a "warm" family. As you wander through the interplay of the familiar and the strange, memories of the past flood in, revealing the hidden tragedy of this family. The game is based on realistic home environments and features a first-person perspective. With "dreamcore" art effects and immersive sound design, it provides players with an extremely lifelike experience!
